title: Crol's Exercise State
description: Made a Stamina Sys + Carrying Sys in Minecraft
body:
# Crol's Exercise States
A mod that adds a **stamina** sys and **Weight** sys to **Minecraft**.

## 🗞️Feature

### Stamina & Weight
- Sprinting and climbing consume stamina.
- Low health and Hunger reduce max stamina to 60.
- Exhaustion lock period when stamina hits 0.(8s)
- Armor Load: The weight is assessed based on the armor value of the armor the player is wearing.
- Weight affects movement speed:
- Below 50%: No penalty.
- 50-70: Slight slowdown.
- 70-100: Moderate slodown.

### HUD colors
- You can change the colors of the three HUD states by adding a config mod.(Stamina HUD Only)

## ℹ️Notice
1. This mod is aimed at the new mechanics added in survival mode,So players who aren’t playing in Survival or Adventure mode, don’t add this mod.
2. Since this mod is the first project, its updates are pretty slow. So it won't be abandoned before being officially Related Notice announced .
  

## 🔗Dependencies
- Fabric API
- Colth Config API
- Mod Menu

## 🖥️Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Only
